articles.title: Redotpay Said to Prepare Confidential IPO Filing By Year-End
articles.summary: Crypto firm Redotpay is considering filing confidentially for a US initial public offering by year-end, according to people familiar with the matter, after months of deliberation and wrangling with regulatory issues.

articles.title: Lula Upset Jolts Brazil Assets, Emerging Stocks Sink to July Low
articles.summary: Brazil’s surprise election result dominated emerging-market trading Monday as the country’s stocks, currencies and debt plunged following Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva victory.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia’s Houthi Challenge Shifts Fears to Non-Oil Economy
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia’s oil industry managed to ride out concerns in the early days of the Iran war and keep exports flowing. Now, with the Houthis staging deadly attacks on the kingdom and signs of disruption stacking up, the worry has shifted to the rest of the economy.

articles.title: Citadel Securities’ Shah Says AI Trade Has No ‘Margin for Error’
articles.summary: Markets have become so invested in the artificial intelligence trade that there is very little room for error if the massive spending doesn’t pay off, according to Citadel Securities.

articles.title: Gasoline Prices Under Trump Surpass Biden-Era Average
articles.summary: The average price Americans are paying for gasoline under President Donald Trump has overtaken the average during the Biden administration, underscoring the political pressure on Republicans ahead of the midterm elections.

articles.title: Wheat Erases Black Sea Premium as Russia Signals Shipping Talks
articles.summary: Wheat futures erased the Black Sea risk premium that had built since Russia and Ukraine escalated attacks in early July, after a report that Moscow is considering proposals to secure grain shipments through the region.
